purpose: Evaluate deterministic answer generation, reference-answer quality, and retrieved-context grounding on the frozen PRIMARY TechQA VALIDATION population without opening TechQA TEST or changing Phase 4.

construct_boundaries.global_question_answerability: Dataset-level property indicating whether the benchmark declares a question answerable; never the Phase 5 grounding target.
construct_boundaries.retrieval_conditioned_context_sufficienc: Frozen Phase 3 y_suff_final for one question, retrieval strategy, depth, and retrieved bundle; evaluation-only metadata in Phase 5.
construct_boundaries.generated_answer_grounding: Whether claims in a generated answer are supported by the exact prompt-visible retrieved context, estimated by the separately validated automatic grounding proxy.

generator.chat_rendering: tokenizer.apply_chat_template with one user message and add_generation_prompt=true

context_assembly.budget_scope: complete chat-templated input including instructions, question, context headers, separators, and generation prefix
context_assembly.full_context_rule: include every retrieved chunk when the complete chat-templated input is at most maximum_input_tokens
context_assembly.truncation_rule: include complete earlier chunks in rank order; if needed, token-truncate only the final included chunk to the largest deterministic prefix that fits; never skip an earlier chunk
context_assembly.empty_chunk_rule: fail the state because frozen retrieval chunks must be non-empty
context_assembly.k10_additional_context_stop_rule: stop before scientific interpretation if k10 fails to expose additional prompt-visible chunk text beyond k5 for 20 percent or more of the 89 questions

generation.normalization: Unicode NFKC, CRLF/CR to LF, collapse Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space, strip leading/trailing whitespace
generation.retry: at most one infrastructure retry with byte-identical inputs and identical settings; output quality never controls retry
generation.empty_output: persist empty_output; reference-answer and grounding metrics are NA
generation.generation_failure: persist generation_failed; do not convert to empty text
generation.zero_evaluable_claims: persist no_evaluable_claim; grounding rates are NA

answer_quality.reference_input_boundary: benchmark answers are loaded only after generation artifacts are complete and closed
answer_quality.undefined_metric_rule: NA for generation failures, empty outputs, missing usable references, and policy abstentions; never zero-fill

claim_segmentation.input_normalization: CRLF/CR to LF only before boundary detection; trim segment-edge whitespace without rewriting internal content
claim_segmentation.bullet_boundaries: leading -, *, Unicode bullet, numbered list, or lettered list marker begins a segment and the marker is excluded
claim_segmentation.substantive_rule: retain a non-empty segment containing at least one Unicode alphanumeric character
claim_segmentation.source_offsets: zero-based half-open character offsets into raw generated response
claim_segmentation.zero_claim_rule: claim_count=0 and response grounding metrics requiring claims are NA

grounding_evaluator.interpretation: automatic retrieved-context support proxy; not hallucination probability
grounding_evaluator.candidate_similarity: exact dot product of normalized embeddings (cosine)
grounding_evaluator.premise_rule: score each of the three candidate chunks independently as premise against the unchanged claim as hypothesis
grounding_evaluator.premise_truncation: Phase 3-compatible deterministic head-and-tail retention within the 256-token pair budget
grounding_evaluator.unevaluable_rule: if an unchanged claim plus pair special tokens cannot fit, persist evaluator_unevaluable and do not score or classify it
grounding_evaluator.claim_support_score: maximum entailment probability over evaluable candidate chunks
grounding_evaluator.contradiction_score: maximum contradiction probability over candidate chunks
grounding_evaluator.supporting_chunk: candidate chunk with maximum entailment; ties use lower rank then ascending chunk_id

ragtruth_validation.passage_parser: split the source_info.passages string at case-insensitive line-start markers matching passage <integer>:; preserve marker order and passage text
ragtruth_validation.span_alignment_audit: all supplied QA human-label offsets reproduce their labelled substrings before scoring
ragtruth_validation.human_claim_label: unsupported exactly when at least one supplied human hallucination span has positive-width overlap with the claim interval; otherwise supported
ragtruth_validation.human_response_label: contains unsupported content exactly when the dataset supplies at least one human hallucination label
ragtruth_validation.implicit_true_primary_handling: retained as unsupported because it is unsupported by supplied context
ragtruth_validation.response_prediction: contains unsupported content when any evaluable claim is classified unsupported
ragtruth_validation.response_continuous_score: maximum claim unsupportedness among evaluable claims
ragtruth_validation.zero_evaluable_claim_response: exclude from grounding metric denominator and report count

bootstrap.duplicate_cluster_handling: every sampled source occurrence contributes all of its QA responses and claims

ragtruth_validation.validity_interpretation_rule: if primary good-quality response-level TEST AUROC is below 0.60, binary TechQA grounding results are exploratory; do not retune or search another evaluator

techqa_grounding.unsupported_claim_rate: unsupported evaluable claims divided by evaluable claims; NA when evaluable_claim_count is zero
techqa_grounding.mean_claim_support_score: arithmetic mean over evaluable claims; NA when none
techqa_grounding.minimum_claim_support_score: minimum over evaluable claims; NA when none
techqa_grounding.maximum_claim_contradiction: maximum over evaluable claims; NA when none
techqa_grounding.fully_supported_response: true only when at least one evaluable claim exists, unsupported_claim_count is zero, and unevaluable_claim_count is zero; false when at least one claim exists but either condition fails; NA when claim_count is zero

policy_views.generation_reuse: generate each k5/k10 state once and select it; never regenerate by policy

policy_metrics.grounded_answer_yield: fully supported answered trajectories divided by all 89 eligible trajectories
policy_metrics.unsupported_answer_population_rate: answered trajectories with at least one unsupported claim divided by all 89 eligible trajectories

test_seal.ragtruth_test_exception: RAGTruth official TEST is permitted solely for supporting evaluator validation and is not the sealed TechQA final evaluation

serialization.json: UTF-8, sorted keys, indent 2, no NaN, trailing LF
serialization.csv: UTF-8, LF, stable declared column order, empty fields for missing values
serialization.parquet: Phase 2 deterministic PyArrow settings: Parquet 2.6, ZSTD level 9, dictionary disabled, statistics enabled, data page 1.0, row groups at most 65536
serialization.hash: SHA-256 over physical bytes; canonical JSON SHA-256 additionally for configurations
serialization.line_endings: Phase-5-scoped text artifacts are LF through .gitattributes; frozen upstream files are never renormalized

governance.methodology_change_after_results: forbidden; execution failure requires stop and decision request
